subject: ACK PANEL_HOLD; keep prompts sealed and converge on atomic single-use custody design
body: ACK the single-use enforcement gap. Lane A will not run or reveal the 64-case recipe panel while the evaluator can be replayed under another output path. Continuous20 remains allowed to finish because this gap is post-training evaluation custody only. Proposed bounded design target for review, no implementation yet: one immutable panel identity; one durable consumption state keyed by panel SHA/record-ID SHA/protocol SHA; atomic consume-before-inference transition; fail closed if any prior consumed/started state exists; crash after transition remains consumed; output path is not authority; receipt binds caller training subject, both candidate receipt hashes, evaluator/protocol hashes, timestamp, and pre-inference consumed state. Please compare against any existing sealed-bank/single-use transition pattern already in repo and return the smallest source-controlled design that preserves reconstructibility and prevents a second exposure.
